usage: save_incremental_turns.py [-h] [--project PROJECT] --start START
                                 --end END [--content CONTENT] [--file FILE]
                                 [--session-id SESSION_ID]

Save 20-turn incremental block to ChromaDB session memory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT     Project name (default: git repository root name)
  --start START         Starting turn index
  --end END             Ending turn index
  --content CONTENT     Integral text content of the turns
  --file FILE           Path to a text/markdown file with the turns
  --session-id SESSION_ID
                        Optional session identifier
